segments.text: Call him, is that right?
Senator Humphrey, please.
Okay, sir, I have Governor Rockefeller now.
Okay.
Go ahead.
Mr. President.
Hi, Nelson, how are you?
You've done the impossible.
I just got back from the Shore Motel, and they told me you'd called.
Aren't you the night?
You know, it's so hard to get through those shouting crowds, and I just didn't do it.
Well, it was great, the whole thing. I can't tell you how much we owe.
Well, I'll tell you, you know, you did just what you said you'd do in New York.
I'm your friend.
When did it come out, finally, in New York?
Well, the television now is saying 59.
Isn't that something?
Well, listen.
59 in New York?
Huh?
That's going to be well over a million.
Oh, gosh, yes.
That's terrific.
Well, and you've still got a good chance of carrying New York City.
God, isn't that something?
It's unbelievable.
Well, you may end up with 60, then, if you carry the city.
That's right, see.
and they say 42% of the Jewish folks.
Oh, my God.
Well, I give you credit for that.
No, I'm serious.
I don't want to say the whole thing.
We're just here with you.
Well, where did I get you at home?
Yeah, I'm just thrilled.
I'll tell you.
Well, that's good.
I was waiting around for McGovern to make a statement, you know, so late.
I mean, you know, that our network for conceding it at 7 o'clock.
That's right.
I don't believe it.
We've been watching it all the time.
All right.
Well, but I'll tell you, it's a great day.
The only state now that we've lost is Massachusetts.
Really? Did you get Washington, D.C., too?
Oh, no, no, no, no. We lost that.
Minnesota, there's some doubt about it. We don't know.
But I suppose we get it. But that's quite something.
Oh, it's just unbelievable.
We couldn't do too well.
Oh, tell me, did you, by any chance, what did you do in any of those house races, or do you know yet?
Oh, yes. We won. Pizer won. He knocked out Otter, which was great.
Brownie Reed, unfortunately, beat out Gary.
And Joe Boyd was beaten out on the island by Otter's bike.
Well, we got down. We knocked out Dow.
Right.
So, then the rest of us...
So, it's a wash, huh?
Yeah. We picked up two.
We picked up two. Oh, I see.
Yeah.
Well, that's great.
That's great.
Well, now, I'm going to Florida tomorrow, I think, for a week,
and then we ought to have a little chat if you have time.
What are you going to do?
I'm looking for, we're going to go out to the country and go to the camp.
Great, great, great.
We're going to go out in the country.
Well, you feel good, though, do you?
You know, incidentally, wasn't that fellow unbelievably irresponsible in the last two days, those charges?
Did you know, for your information, Henry may have told you,
When I was on the airfield at North Carolina Saturday, we got a wire from the North Vietnamese.
They've agreed to negotiate without conditions in one week.
It's all done.
We never said it.
But, you know, that's what you have to do.
Did you ever see such an irresponsible campaign as this clown put on?
No, not a Chris.
He's running me with many roses.
But what a babbler.
But, you know, I'll tell you.
Let me tell you, Mr. President.
And I saw your daughter, Tricia, in New York on television, and I told her what McGovern had said.
And the child was so marvelous because it was your reaction.
And she was so controlled, and she was quiet.
And he said, well, freedom of speech is a great thing in this country.
And the pressure of the campaign, she was, I just really, I just thought she was so great.
As a matter of fact, my family felt a little bit, and they said, no, don't say anything nice about him.
But as you noticed, I was very careful to say, look, everybody, you opponents and others, you all fought hard.
Now let's get together.
You've got to be generous.
Don't you think so?
Oh, yes.
I think, Mr. President, this is the greatest thing, and I want to help you in any way I can in trying to do a job now, a domestic thing here.
Right.
Okay.
I got your memo with all your crossovers.
We're with you.
Okay.
We're with you.
You might love to have me.
You bet.
Bye.
Love to pat.
Bye.
Thanks for calling.
Thank you.
